chapter: Black and Tan and Kansas City nightlife
title: Learning the Black Bottom, Mess Around and Fishtail
summary: At about twenty-two he learned the dances of the day and explains the Mess Around and Fishtail to Willard.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: By then, how old were you?

Oh, I 'bout twenty-two then. And then I learned how to ...I picked up...learn how to dance. I want to dance. So I learned how to do the Black Bottom, the Mess Around, and all that kinda junk. These are steps you could do by yourself, or you could do it with somebody else, you know.
Never heard of that one. I've heard of the Black Bottom. How...how did the Mess Around go?
You'll get up in the floor and shake yourself.
Around and around...call it the Mess Around. It was simple. That was all the craze then. Doin' the Fishtail.
Don't know about that one either. What else? How was the Fishtail?
The Fishtail--the chick would bend over...shake her behind...call it the Fishtail.
What else were they doin' on the dancefloor? Were there any others?
Oh, they had a lotta dances but I don't remember 'em all. I couldn't keep up with all that stuff.
